category_title: Child with ASD, ADHD, and Specific Learning Disability exhibiting significant behavioral resistance to reading instruction
scenario_title: Initial letter sound instruction and memory retrieval
minimal_context: Sam and his tutor are working one-on-one in a quiet spot to practice remembering the sounds of previously taught letters when a new letter is introduced.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We have a new letter today. But first, let's look at the letter we learned yesterday. What sound does this one make?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks away) I don't want to read.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please look at the letter. What sound is it?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't remember! I'm not doing it!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Try to remember. We need to finish this instructional task.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: No! (Gets out of his chair and begins roaming the classroom, screaming and starting to have a meltdown)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: We have a new letter today. But first, let's look at the letter we learned yesterday. What sound does this one make?

STUDENT: (Looks away) I don't want to read.

TUTOR: Please look at the letter. What sound is it?

STUDENT: I don't remember! I'm not doing it!

TUTOR: Try to remember. We need to finish this instructional task.

STUDENT: No! (Gets out of his chair and begins roaming the classroom, screaming and starting to have a meltdown)

task.content: Remembering the sound of a previously taught letter when another was introduced
task.learning_goal: Build upon the knowledge of sounds in order to form words

context.environment: One-to-one instruction in a quiet spot with minimal auditory or visual distractions
context.materials: Points applied to either a small toy or preferred activity
context.time_context: Short instructional sessions of no more than five to ten minutes in duration, repeated several times during the day

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When requested to perform any instructional tasks or when experiencing frustration
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Actively resisted any attempts to be taught academic content, had meltdowns, got out of his chair, and roamed the classroom
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Highly distractible, showed higher levels of anxiety, and expressed no interest in learning to read

behavior_patterns.condition: When asked to do paper/pencil tasks such as drawing and coloring
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Displayed rage-like behaviors and refused to participate

behavior_patterns.condition: When experiencing a change in his routine or frustration
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Exhibited frequent tantrums and meltdowns lasting anywhere from 20 minutes to 2 to 4 hours, sometimes up to three times per day
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Significant difficulty controlling his impulses and controlling emotions
